title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the First League

excerpt.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求第一联盟的知识并为我们所用。
excerpt.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the First League to our own.

title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the First League

texts.zh: 我们的科学家将仔细地对我们收集到的数据进行筛选，探求第一联盟的知识并为我们所用。
texts.en: Our scientists will carefully sift through all of the data we have collected, seeking to add the knowledge of the First League to our own.

texts.zh: 第一联盟证明了信赖其他种族是愚蠢的，这只会招致孱弱不堪和自我毁灭。然而，他们的一些先进建筑方法，或许多少能够为我们所用。
texts.en: The First League proves that reliance on other races is folly that leads to weakness and self-destruction. Some of their advanced construction methods may, however, be of possible use.

texts.zh: 我们已成功将第一联盟文物融入我们的科研进程。他们对工业科技的见解将极大地帮助我们。
texts.en: We have successfully managed to integrate the First League artifacts into our research process. Their insights into industrial research will greatly aid our own.
